findings.title: Refund policy contradicts the one stated in task-001
findings.why: task-001 says the refund policy is 'none under 24 h before start, else full'. `cancel` instead refunds in full whenever `at` is before the start and nothing from the start on. A cancellation 2 hours before the start therefore gets a full refund, where task-001 says none. task-005 calls its policy an unconfirmed assumption and says 'the request gave none'. That is wrong, because task-001 already gave one. The 24 h rule is never implemented or tested.

findings.title: Plan documents are unfilled scaffolds with status active
findings.why: The four plan files (1-2 to 1-5) contain only the template placeholder comment, with empty `element` and `parent` fields. The tasks they describe are already implemented. The same scaffold comment is also left in every task file. The comment itself says to replace it.
